summary.text: Scott Nasiff is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a small business owner and president of his business.

paragraphs.text: Scott Nasiff earned a bachelor's degree from Assumption University and a graduate degree from American University in Washington, D.C.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as the middle-class son of a small business owner and a public school teacher, a husband and father of three, and a small business owner who has lived from Massachusetts to Arizona before making North Carolina his home.
Nasiff advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, which was canceled.

In the survey, he named three campaign messages: reinvesting in public education and ending school vouchers, requiring developers to pay impact fees as part of responsible growth, and addressing PFAS contamination of drinking water in the Cape Fear River.
